I'd be very careful around this area Demand created by demand etc is always to be considered stacked demand, and price can go all the way Sure there are retrace trades to be taken on many timeframes, but beware that orders may accumulate for a wile around this level, which can be frustrating if you're looking for an easy swing

author: AlexC
text:
swan wrote: Hi! everyone first post here. I would like to say thanks for sharing your knowledge so freely.

Can anyone correct me if I have this wrong on inverted Pin Bars

Hi Swan, good to have you here. In Japanese candles terminology, the second candlestick you point to is called a hanging man and the real body is at the upper end of the trading range. When found at the top of an uptrend it's a potential reversal. A bearish candle following is the confirmation.
